v: What causes conflicts and quarrels among you? Don’t they come from the passions at war within you?
From where {are} wars and from where {are} battles among you? {Are they} not from there, from your lusts, the ones fighting in your members?

I will tell you why you are fighting among yourselves and quarreling with each other. It is because each of you inwardly desires to do evil things. Those desires lead you to fight {in order to be able to do those things}.
desires to do evil things Those desires
desires to do evil things Those desires
desires to do evil things Those desires
You crave what you do not have; you kill and covet, but are unable to obtain it. You quarrel and fight. You do not have, because you do not ask.
You covet, and you do not have. You kill and envy, and you are not able to obtain. You battle and war. You do not have because you do not ask.

You desire to have things, but you do not get {them}. This makes you bitterly resent the people who do have them. But you {still} do not get {what you want}, so you quarrel and fight {with others}. If you pray {to God} instead {for the things you desire}, then God will give you {what you truly need}.
This makes you bitterly resent the people who do have them
This makes you bitterly resent the people who do have them
This makes you bitterly resent the people who do have them
And when you do ask, you do not receive, because you ask with wrong motives, that you may squander it on your pleasures.
You ask and you do not receive, because you ask badly, so that you may spend on your lusts. \*

But even when you do ask God for things, he does not give them to you, because you are asking with bad motives. You are asking for things just so that you can use them to enjoy yourselves in wrong ways. \*
But even when you do ask God for things
You adulteresses! Do you not know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Therefore, whoever chooses to be a friend of the world renders himself an enemy of God.
You adulteresses! Do you not know that the friendship with the world is enmity with God? Therefore whoever wants to be a friend of the world is made an enemy of God.

You are being disloyal to God {by not obeying him}! You must realize that those who behave as evil people do are hostile to God. So if that is how you decide to live, then you will be choosing to be hostile to God.
You are being disloyal to God
those who behave as evil people do

Or do you think the Scripture says without reason that the Spirit He caused to dwell in us yearns with envy?
Or do you think that the scripture says vainly, “The Spirit whom he caused to live in us longs with jealousy”? \*
You must realize that God has purposely told us about this in the Scriptures. There he teaches us that the Spirit he placed in us yearns for us to live our lives in ways that please him. \*
for us to live our lives in ways that please him
for us to live our lives in ways that please him
But He gives us more grace. This is why it says: “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
But he gives greater grace. Therefore it says, “God opposes the proud, but he gives grace to the humble.”

If we are living in ways that do not please God, he is very kind to us. {He will help us live differently if we humbly admit that we have been doing wrong.} That is why this teaching is in the Bible: “God does not help those who are proud, but he does help those who are humble.”
If we are living in ways that do not please God
this teaching is in the Bible
if we humbly admit that we have been doing wrong
Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
Be submitted, therefore, to God. But resist the devil, and he will flee from you. \*
So choose humbly to obey God. Firmly determine not to give in to the devil’s temptations. This will make the devil give up on trying to tempt you. \*
Firmly determine not to give in
the devil give up on trying to tempt
the devil give up on trying to tempt
Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.
Come near to God and he will come near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, double-minded.

Be honest and open with God. If you do, he will welcome you into his presence. You who are sinners, turn away from doing what is wrong and do only what is right. You who cannot decide whether you will commit yourselves to God, stop thinking wrong thoughts and think only right thoughts.
turn away from doing what is wrong and do only what is right
turn away from doing what is wrong and do only what is right
stop thinking wrong thoughts and think only right thoughts
stop thinking wrong thoughts and think only right thoughts
You who cannot decide whether you will commit yourselves to God
Grieve, mourn, and weep. Turn your laughter to mourning, and your joy to gloom.
Be miserable and mourn and weep! Let your laughter be changed into mourning, and your joy into gloom.
Show sorrow and be sad and weep {because of the wrong things that you have done}. You have been enjoying yourselves, but you should be serious {and realize how much you need to change}.
Humble yourselves before the Lord, and He will exalt you.
Be humbled before the Lord, and he will lift you up. \*
Humbly show the Lord how sorry you are for your sins. If you do that, he will honor you. \*

Brothers, do not slander one another. Anyone who speaks against his brother or judges him speaks against the law and judges it. And if you judge the law, you are not a practitioner of the law, but a judge of it.

Do not speak against one another, brothers. The one speaking against a brother or judging his brother speaks against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law, but a judge.

My fellow believers, stop accusing one another of doing wrong. Anyone who accuses and condemns a fellow believer is really accusing and condemning God’s commandment {that we should love one another}. But if you speak against that commandment, you are not obeying it. Instead, you are acting like a judge who condemns it.
that we should love one another
that we should love one another
you are acting like a judge who condemns
There is only one Lawgiver and Judge, the One who is able to save and destroy. But who are you to judge your neighbor?
There is one lawgiver and judge, the one being able to save and to destroy. But who are you, the one judging your neighbor? \*

The only one who can judge people {according to the law} is the one who gave the law. That is God, who is able not just to condemn people {for breaking the law} but also to pardon them {even though they have broken the law}. You certainly are not entitled to take God’s place and judge others. \*
the one who gave the law
You certainly are not entitled to take God s place
You certainly are not entitled to take God s place
You certainly are not entitled to take God s place
You certainly are not entitled to take God s place
Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow we will go to this or that city, spend a year there, carry on business, and make a profit.
Come now, you ones saying, “Today or tomorrow we will travel to this city and do a year there and trade and gain.”
Some of you are {arrogantly} saying, “Today or tomorrow we will go to a certain city. We will spend a year there and we will buy and sell things and earn a lot of money.” Now you listen to me!
we will buy and sell things
You do not even know what will happen tomorrow! What is your life? You are a mist that appears for a little while and then vanishes.
You who do not know the thing of the tomorrow, of what sort {is} your life? For you are a mist that appears for a little {while} and then disappears. \*

You should not talk like that, because you do not know what will happen tomorrow. In fact, you do not even know how long you will live! After all, your life is short, like a mist that is visible briefly but then vanishes. \*
You should not talk like that because
Instead, you ought to say, “If the Lord is willing, we will live and do this or that.
Instead, you should say, “If the Lord wishes, we will both live and do this or that.”
Instead {of what you are saying,} you should say, “If the Lord is willing, we will still be alive and we will be able to do one thing or another.”
we will be able to do
As it is, you boast in your proud intentions. All such boasting is evil.
But now you are boasting in your pretensions. All such boasting is evil.
But what you are doing is bragging about all the things you plan to do. That kind of bragging is sinful.
Anyone, then, who knows the right thing to do, yet fails to do it, is guilty of sin.
Therefore to the one having known to do good and not doing {it}, to him it is sin. \*
So if anyone does not do something even though he knows it is the right thing that he should do, he has committed a sin. \*
